description: This file defines the PresentationMessage class which encapsulates a user-facing message along with associated information such as code, locale, and description. It serves as part of the presentation layer for message display in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: PresentationMessage
classes.description: A class representing a message intended for presentation to a user, including metadata such as code, locale, and description.

methods.name: PresentationMessage
methods.description: Constructor for creating a fully specified PresentationMessage instance.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the Locale object associated with this message.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the Locale object for this message.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message text to be shown to the user.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message text to be shown to the user.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the message, indicating its meaning or use.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the message.
